product.description: Monoprice™ Cornerstone SeriesCorner‑Friendly Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount BracketFor 32" ~ 70" flat and curved TVs weighing up to 99 poundsThis Monoprice™ Cornerstone Series Corner‑Friendly Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket is designed specifically for corner installations. The unique, dual mounting arms can move independently, allowing it to be easily installed on flat walls, or to allow centered or off‑centered corner installations. It can be swiveled, tilted, and extended, so you can adjust your TV's position and angle to ensure maximum viewing comfort. This versatile wall mount is also designed to fit both curved and curved flat screen displays.Fits VESA® patterns from 75x75 ~ 600x400Designed for 32" ~ 70" displaysSupports displays weighing up to 99 poundsCan be mounted to flat walls, as well as with centered or off‑centered corner installationsUnique dual‑arm, full‑motion design±45° swivel range+5° ~ ‑15° tilt range±3° rotation rangeFits both curved and flat screen displays CORNER‑FRIENDLY FULL‑MOTION ARTICULATING DESIGNThis Monoprice™ Corner‑Friendly Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket offers the ultimate in comfort and flexibility. The unique design of this Cornerstone Series mount gives you the ability to mount your TV in a corner and adjust it to any angle, giving maximum viewing flexibility while saving space. The articulating dual swing arms allow you to extend the TV away from or retract it towards the wall, tilt it up or down, and angle it from side to side. The articulating plate holding the TV also allows you to rotate the display to ensure it is level. "IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"Check your TV's manual for its VESA® mounting pattern or measure the horizontal and vertical distances between the mounting holes (in mm).This mount supports VESA patterns between 75x75 and 600x400.This mount supports TVs weighing up to 99 pounds.The screen size range is only a suggested approximation. Your TV is compatible as long as its VESA mounting pattern is between 75x75 and 600x400 and it weighs no more than 99 pounds.FITS BOTH CURVED AND FLAT SCREEN DISPLAYSThis Corner‑Friendly Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket is designed for both curved and flat screen displays. STATE‑OF‑THE‑ART STEEL CONSTRUCTIONThis Monoprice™ Cornerstone Series Corner‑Friendly Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket is constructed from high quality, cold‑rolled steel, which gives it a strong, heavy‑duty build that is capable of supporting up to 99 pounds. It also features a lighter build compared to older, bulkier TV mounts. It can be easily mounted to brick, concrete, or wood stud walls. CONVENIENT SET OF ESSENTIAL MOUNTING ACCESSORIESThis Monoprice™ Cornerstone Series Corner‑Friendly Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket includes a variety of screws, washers, and bushings to mount both curved and flat screen displays, as well as screws and anchors for mounting it to both wood stud and brick/concrete ceilings. We also include a box wrench for your convenience.RECOMMENDED TOOLSThe following tools are highly recommended for making the installation of your wall mount as safe and straightforward as possible.
